red_tape.note: A 2019 Landesrechnungshof Tirol audit report records the Land's culture department saying the Kunsthalle's international exhibition work was often hard to reconcile with Land administration rules on contracts, hiring and travel, and states that approving individual business trips repeatedly caused problems.

basis: Governance: the legal notice names TAXISPALAIS Kunsthalle Tirol GmbH as a subsidiary of Tiroler Landesmuseen-Betriebsgesellschaft m.b.H., and the Landesrechnungshof Tirol press release of 18 June 2026 reports the audit of the Landesmuseen and the decision to dissolve the subsidiary into them on 1 January 2027, so the GmbH is the form in force today. Red tape: the 2019 Landesrechnungshof report, section on administrative problems in the integration chapter and section on business trip approvals.
